name: Mahjong Gensoukyoku
source:
The hero was a prince of a small country but he became just an adventurer after a witch destroyed his country. He studies to be a mahjong warrior and participates in mahjong competition with the hand of Tanya as the prize.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/06/vn-of-month-june-1992.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公原本是一个小国的王子，但国家遭魔女毁灭后，他沦为普通冒险者。他学习成为麻将战士，并参加一场麻将大赛；冠军的奖品是迎娶塔妮娅。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/06/vn-of-month-june-1992.html]vndbreview[/url]]
